name: mod-hub
description: A bar above the prompt with your pinned commands and a prompt-cache countdown, a /mod-manager pane to turn mods on and off, run them and save presets of your setup, and /hub: a live web control room for every mod.

port.title: Hub port
port.description: The local port the Mod Hub web app listens on.

showBar.title: Show the bar above the prompt
showBar.description: The row of pinned commands and the Mods and Hub buttons. Off hides it; /mod-manager and /hub still work.

cacheTtl.title: Prompt cache lifetime
cacheTtl.description: auto learns it from your requests (5 min until one shows it lasts an hour). Set 5m or 1h to fix it.
